story.text: You are Ash the grumpy of Inferno. Lately you suffered great losses at the hand of your arc-rival Tazar from Fortress. Ever since they allied themselves with Dessa and Dracon it has been only setback after setback, you must gather you strength and vanquish these devils before all is lost.

actInfo.label: Act info
actInfo.text:
The Starting tile must be your factions stating tile. 
Do not use Event-cards for this campaign.
Your buildings, income, units and secondary hero will follow through the campaign unless otherwise specified.
If your hero looses all units your campaign has fail and the game is over.
If you do not fulfill the victory condition when the last round is over your campaign has fail and the game is over.
Add the following AI behaviors when fighting each of the other faction leaders throughout the campaign:
Tazar :Increase defence of their first 2 unit to be attacked by 1 each round
Dessa :Increase all units initiative by 2 when combat begins.
Dracon :Replace Magi with Enchanters, if packed add a stack-token
When Visiting an Obelisk: Resolve 1 treasure dice

aiRules: The AI spawns at the center tile with 0MP unless otherwise specified.
The AI gains MP each round (default 3) which it moves towards the nearest player hero at the end of the round, disregarding "Fog of war" and can stand on any unrevealed field.
Spawn any new AI's before moving any currently active AI's
The AI army composition is determined at first combat encounter.
AI faction armies >faction< (if random) is determined when the field it stands on is revealed or it lands on a revealed field.
The AI army losses is permanent, unless otherwise specified
Battling the AI costs no MP to extend.
If two AI armies are nearest to the same player hero the furthest AI will move towards the second nearest hero if possible.
If the closest hero is hiding in a sanctuary, the AI will permanently move towards their town.
The AI does not take fields or mines.
The AI army will NOT use a monolith, Unless there is no path to any hero, or a hero used it this round.
Defeating any AI army gives ½XP and Search (4) artifact deck

glossary.text: Draw 5 random cards from the stack and initiate combat as normal, any enemy units who die are removed from the stack, the field is won when the last unit of the stack has been defeated.
Similar to the enemy stack, but when an enemy is killed draw a new unit card from the stack and place it on the the enemy back line.
All enemy units in a combat must all be defeated to be removed from the stack otherwise they are return to the stack.

An AI army of neutral units who uses AI mechanics.
An army of an unused faction does NOT use AI mechanics.
